triggerid.description: ID of the trigger to update.

expression.description:
Trigger expression.

Items with value_type set to 5 (binary) cannot be used in trigger expressions.

event_name.description: Event name generated by the trigger.

status.description:
Whether the trigger is enabled or disabled.

Possible values:
0 - (default) enabled;
1 - disabled.

type.description:
Whether the trigger can generate multiple problem events.

Possible values:
0 - (default) do not generate multiple events;
1 - generate multiple events.

url_name.description: Label for the URL associated with the trigger.

recovery_expression.description:
Trigger recovery expression.

Items with value_type set to 5 (binary) cannot be used in trigger recovery expressions.

correlation_mode.description:
OK event closes.

Possible values:
0 - (default) All problems;
1 - All problems if tag values match.

manual_close.description:
Allow manual close.

Possible values:
0 - (default) No;
1 - Yes.

uuid.description:
Universal unique identifier, used for linking imported triggers to already existing ones. Auto-generated, if not given.

Supported if the trigger belongs to a template.

items.description: Trigger that this trigger is dependent on. The triggers must have only the triggerid property defined.

triggerid.description: ID of the trigger that this trigger depends on.

dependencies.description:
Triggers that the trigger is dependent on.

The triggers must have only the triggerid property defined.
